azure.review.devops.selected_content_sec.title: Selected Azure DevOps source and pipeline literals have no detected secrets
azure.review.devops.selected_content_sec.description: Inspect only selected Azure DevOps Git files at immutable commits and selected pipeline definition literals using both pinned offline detectors.
azure.review.devops.selected_content_sec.purpose: Bounded selected source declarations only; no token validation, execution, template expansion, protected values or project-wide coverage.
azure.review.devops.selected_content_sec.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in the selected Azure DevOps literals. Coverage is limited to the selected file commit and pipeline definition revision.
azure.review.devops.selected_content_sec.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in selected Azure DevOps literals. The value is hidden and was not validated.
azure.review.devops.selected_content_sec.missing_observation: Selected Azure DevOps literal content was unavailable, unbound or incompletely inspected. A clean result cannot be established.
azure.review.devops.selected_content_sec.remediation: Remove exposed literals from the selected source or nonsecret pipeline variables and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use supported secret references or workload identities.
remediation_steps: Remove confirmed credential literals from the selected file and configured nonsecret variables.
Rotate or revoke confirmed exposed credentials using the credential owner process.
Use supported secret references or workload identities and rerun with the exact updated commit/revision.
